title: After the end date no notice and no pill show anywhere
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Know the end date of the "New" pill for the build under test: 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships Technician Toggle (until that release is scheduled, the build carries 31 Dec 2026, 07:00 UTC).
  • Set your computer's clock to one day after that end date.
  • Have any active staff member, staff member A.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Technician column header in the Active tab.
  2. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  3. Close the Edit Staff Member window.
  4. Open the New Staff Member window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • No notice shows above the tabs.
  • The Technician column shows with no "New" pill.

Step 2:

  • The Edit Staff Member window shows the Technician toggle with no "New" pill.

Step 3:

  • The window closes.

Step 4:

  • The New Staff Member window shows the Technician toggle with no "New" pill.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11882 (Story 4, Technician column and notice on the staff list)

  • S4-N2: “After the end date, neither the notice nor the pills show anywhere.”
  • S4-R5: “The notice cannot be closed. It disappears for everyone at the same moment as the "New" pill (S1-R2), including in a page that is already open.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "1 Staff list", picture "Notice and Technician column" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p1-02-after-notice-and-technician-column.png

The design's own words:

  • “Notice, verbatim: "New: Decide who appears on Board View, Tech View and the technician dropdowns. Turn Technician on or off for each person in their staff settings, next to Sales Representative. To start, it is on for everyone who worked on a work order in the last 90 days, is on open work, or is billable."”
  • “No close button: it disappears for everyone on the "New" pill's end date.”
  • “Technician column, read-only and sortable, just left of Billable: Yes when the person's Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on, otherwise No. A deactivated person always shows No. It changes only through the staff window (page 2).”
  • “"New" pill at the top right of the Technician header. It goes away at 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships this; the exact date is set when the release is scheduled.”

The after-the-end-date state is not drawn (register TT-N17).
